mechanism.family: Advance-fee loan scam: online lender requires fees before disbursement, paid to a private individual
mechanism.summary: The captured BFCAO page promises personal loans of 5 000 to 40 000 000 EUR at a fixed 3 %, a '100 % online bank' with a '250 000 kr' testimonial on a French page. Added: the application requires a non-refundable file fee (6 %) wired to a named private person before any funds are released, followed by a second 'guarantee' payment.

v11_fixes.note: English footer, placeholder and carousel button labels translated to French.

aria-label on links and buttons whose visible text it did not contain now carries that text (visible text first, or the label replaced by the visible text), so the accessible name contains what is shown.

links that led nowhere now open a page of the site, or read as plain text where the site has no such page; short About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Help or Refund pages were added only where the site names one, and restate what the site already says.

the hero carousel's previous and next arrows now move between its slides (the Ouvrir un compte buttons are untouched), the newsletter box answers in French (missing, malformed or valid e-mail), the back-to-top button scrolls up, and the four footer social icons that pointed to a missing anchor no longer carry a href.
the hero carousel skips the slide whose background picture was not captured.
